g.text: Estimator mixture in the recorded simultaneous comparisons
Known and new seed cohorts were both observed previously. Each case has weight one in the parent reporting group.
Stratum weights are carried from that group; cases may cross strata. All event kinds, including overlapping unions, remain in the saved analysis.
